title: Driveway set back 0.3 m from a side lot boundary or street pole

replaces.note: side boundary clearance 0.5 m -> 0.3 m; 9 m aggregate width limit deleted

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: Chapter 3 C3.7.3(iii) (p40) is a 0.3 m setback from a side lot boundary or street pole; Chapter 2 C3.7.3(iii) is the R35-and-below 9 m aggregate width limit, which Chapter 3 does not have. Fact is the least clearance of any driveway to a side lot boundary or street pole (proposed fact). Part B required 0.5 m.
text: Driveways must be: iii. set back 0.3m from a side lot boundary or street pole;
